blueprint.summary: Cleveland Browns hold $12.14M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($12.14M effective) and +$61.25M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Andrew Berry and the Browns front office hold $12.14M in gross 2026 cap space ($12.14M effective), while 2027 currently projects at +$61.25M under an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($5M–$9M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Deshaun Watson, Denzel Ward, Jerry Jeudy, Mason Graham.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($5M–$9M Target vs. +$61.25M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Cleveland's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
